sample_dialogue: вот такая хуйня собачка, вот такая соба хуйнячка, вот такачка соба хуйня, така вотачка соба хуйня
performance_prompt: Native Russian male, around 50. Low, dry, ordinary speaking voice. Speak quietly and calmly, almost monotone, as if sitting alone and absent-mindedly muttering a thought under your breath. Keep the pitch nearly level and the volume slightly subdued. Medium conversational speed, compact connected words, short vowels, and only tiny natural pauses between the repeated fragments. No acting, storytelling performance, stage diction, dramatic emphasis, emotional color, irony, punchline signaling, smiling voice, or rhetorical rise. Do not sound sleepy or painfully slow. Plain, restrained, private self-talk.
